items.title: The degree of a locally free module on a proper scheme of dimension at most one is the multiplicity-weighted sum of its degrees on the one-dimensional components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma expresses the degree of a locally free module on a proper scheme of dimension at most one as the sum over the one-dimensional irreducible components of the multiplicity times the degree of the restriction. The proof isolates each component by taking the complement of the union of the others and the scheme theoretic closure X_i of that open piece, uses the birational-invariance lemma for the coproduct morphism, and so reduces to the irreducible case (proof lines 9726-9741). There it must show deg(E) = m deg(E|_C) for the reduced structure C of multiplicity m, which it does by induction on the nilpotency index e of the ideal of C, using the short exact sequence 0 -> I^e -> O_X -> O_{X'} -> 0 and an additivity computation of lengths at the generic point (proof lines 9744-9781). H3: the reduction to components together with the nilpotency induction and the length computation is independent research-level work.
